label: OpenRouter
description: Serve LLM calls through OpenRouter: pick the connection (the built-in credits connection, or your own OpenRouter API key) and the model, and wire the provider output into any LLM node. One provider node, picked once, however many calls consume it.

steps: Open openrouter.ai/keys and create an API key.
Paste it below and name the connection.

inputs.name: servingProvider
inputs.label: Serving provider
inputs.description: Serve the model from one specific OpenRouter provider (anthropic, fireworks, amazon-bedrock, ...). Leave empty to let OpenRouter route. Providers charge different rates for the same model, so pinning one also pins the price.

inputs.name: providerFallbacks
inputs.label: Allow provider fallbacks
inputs.description: Fall back to other serving providers when the preferred one (the pin above, or OpenRouter's top-ranked choice) is unavailable. On by default. Turning it off makes the call fail rather than be served (and billed) by someone else.

outputs.name: provider
outputs.description: The provider value: wire it into an LLM node's provider input.

then.message: OpenRouterProvider '{id}' has no model; name one on the node.
